name: letter-morph
title: Letter Morph
description: A label that morphs letter by letter: shared letters slide to new places as others float away or rise in.

perf.budget: One text view per letter, moved by transforms on the UI thread; each new character is measured once. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: The demo changes the headline every 1.8 s, so it draws at rest; the long p99 frame is the first appearance of a new character, which is measured once.

a11y.reducedMotion: The new text replaces the old at once.
a11y.screenReader: One text element that reads the whole label; the letters themselves are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive itself; put it inside a button for actions.
